documents.text: Our standard refund window is 30 days from the date of purchase. To request a refund, open a ticket with your order number and our support team will process it within 5 business days. Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

Effective June 2025, the refund window is 14 days from the date of purchase. This policy replaces the previous 30 day window. Tickets must include the order number. Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Express shipping is available at checkout for an additional fee. Orders placed before noon ship the same day.

expected: Acknowledge that the policy changed: 30 days before June 2025, 14 days after. Cite both documents and state which is current.
